description: She wears a floor-length dark burgundy velvet-like gown with gold vine embroidery over the bodice, sleeves and skirt. A low square neckline has broad gold woven trim; a row of decorated gold and green-toned fastenings runs down the center. The fitted elbow-length sleeves end in patterned cuffs. A cream and gold brocade wrap drapes loosely around her forearms. A cream patterned underdress shows through the front skirt opening, with brown shoes below. A small red-stone pendant rests at the upper chest. She has no headgear or weapons.
